verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor-maintained migration guide or tooling for moving users off a competing auth provider, and nothing about importing password hashes to avoid forced resets. The Third-Party Auth item (using Clerk/Auth0/Firebase/Cognito/WorkOS JWTs with Supabase APIs) lets you keep the other provider rather than migrate off it, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can follow vendor-maintained migration guides or tooling for moving off a competing auth provider without forcing password resets
